**`postgres.DB` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`** (full workspace path `repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go`)

The struct holds the `*sql.DB` handle plus the profile, and `NewDB` returns it as a `store.Driver`:

```16:19:repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

The rest of the `store.Driver` interface is implemented across the sibling files in that package (`memo.go`, `user.go`, `attachment.go`, and so on), all as methods on `*DB`.
